## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty girl with jet-black hair, glossy black tresses, and black curls, inheriting her dark hair and eyes from her mother. She features a merry expression inherited from her father, along with crimson, rosy cheeks and enchanting dimples.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

Diana is a good, smart, and ladylike individual with a naturally merry expression and a practical disposition. Known for her unselfish nature, she holds a genuine admiration for the talents of others. She is skilled in singing, often selected to perform solos, and has earned a strong reputation for her notable taste in dressing.

## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who was boarding with her family when she was born. During her youth, she met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), where they pledged eternal friendship, and they frequently signaled to each other across distance using candle flashes. The girls attended school together, where Diana welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was temporarily forbidden to play with her and when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to attend school following a punishment. Diana also accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on local outings, such as canvassing for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), searching for a willow-ware platter at [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), and discovering Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Over the years, Diana served as a trusted confidante for Anne's creative pursuits, including the creation of a story club in their youth and reviewing Anne's written story, Averil's Atonement. As they grew older, Diana became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) served as a helper when Diana married [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Four years after her marriage, Diana gave birth to a baby boy.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Tempest in the School Teapot P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), +42 more_

## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> "I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly formed a deep friendship, swearing a solemn oath to be bosom friends forever after meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) [S1]. They became dedicated playmates and schoolmates, sharing walks, writing stories together in a story club, and confiding their dreams to one another [S1, S2, S18]. Their bond faced a brief rift when Diana's mother temporarily forbade them from playing together, but they remained loyal through secret notes until reunited after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully saved Diana's sister from croup [S4, S11]. As they grew older, Diana remained Anne's devoted confidante, helping her prepare for major events, celebrating her academic triumphs, and standing by her as life took them down different paths [S13, S14, S29, S30].

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +87 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--shirley.md)

Diana formed a deep, bosom friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), though their bond was temporarily strained when Diana's mother ordered them apart [R9, S27].
